outcome: postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) defined as estimated blood loss >= 1,000 mL
cohort: The study included 532 women with twin gestations who chose to have an elective cesarean delivery after 28 weeks of gestation at a university hospital in China.
finding: Preeclampsia, premature rupture of membrane, placenta previa, antenatal magnesium sulfate use, and anemia were identified as independent risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage after elective cesarean delivery for twin pregnancies.
